data.name: Havfun
data.detailed_description:
⚠ IMPORTANT — REGIONAL AVAILABILITY

This game is available only in selected regions. Players outside these regions will not be able to connect, even if the game is installed.

This game is not available in Washington State, USA due to local regulations.

Havfun is a free-to-play social entertainment world where players can meet, play, compete, and express themselves together.

Enjoy a variety of casino-style games, casual mini-games, avatar customization, and social activities — all in one place.

ENJOY CASINO-STYLE GAMES

Try your luck in classic casino-style games including Slots, Blackjack, and Roulette. Play casually, enjoy the excitement, and compete for higher rankings.

Havfun is designed for entertainment only. In-game Chips have no real-world monetary value and cannot be exchanged for real money.

PLAY A VARIETY OF MINI-GAMES

Take a break from the casino and jump into a wide selection of casual mini-games, including puzzles, shooting, racing, sports, arcade-style challenges, and more.

Each game offers a different way to play, giving you plenty of activities to enjoy at your own pace.

CLIMB THE RANKINGS

Play games, earn in-game Chips, and challenge other players on the leaderboards.

Compete for your place in daily, weekly, and monthly rankings across a variety of activities.

CREATE YOUR OWN STYLE

Customize your avatar with a variety of outfits, hairstyles, accessories, and other cosmetic items.

Create a look that represents you and explore the Havfun world in your own style.

HANG OUT TOGETHER

Meet other players in shared social spaces, chat, explore, and enjoy activities together.

Whether you're playing mini-games, visiting different areas, or simply hanging out, Havfun gives you a place to connect with players from around the world.

CREATE YOUR OWN SPACE

Decorate your personal space with furniture and various items to create a place of your own.

Customize your home and invite friends to visit and hang out.

FREE TO PLAY

Havfun is free to download and play.

Optional in-game purchases are available for players who want additional items or content. Casino-style gameplay uses virtual Chips intended solely for gameplay and entertainment.

No real-money gambling or cash prizes are offered.

data.legal_notice:
© 2026 NURIWORKS Co., Ltd. All rights reserved.

This game contains simulated casino content for entertainment purposes only. It is not real-money gambling. In-game Chips have no real-world monetary value, cannot be cashed out, redeemed, or exchanged for money or goods, and cannot be traded or transferred between players. No cash prizes are offered.

content_descriptors.notes:
Havfun is a social casino and social world experience intended for adults
(18+).

Simulated gambling: The game features casino-style games including a slot
machine, roulette and blackjack, presented in a casino-themed environment.
These games are played exclusively with "Blue Chip", a virtual in-game
currency. Blue Chip has no cash value, cannot be redeemed or exchanged for
money, cryptocurrency, gift cards, goods or anything of real-world value, and
cannot be traded or transferred between players. The game offers no
real-money gambling, wagering, cash prizes or cash-out of any kind. Outcomes
are for entertainment only.

In-game purchases: Cosmetic and other in-game items can be purchased with
real money through Steam. Blue Chip is not sold on its own; a bonus amount of
Blue Chip is granted alongside certain item purchases. Blue Chip can also be
earned for free through minigames and daily in-game activities.

Online social features: The game includes shared online spaces with other
players and in-game text chat. Player interactions and user-generated content
are not fully predictable and may include material that some users find
objectionable. A word filter is applied to chat, and players can report other
users and block them, which hides the blocked user's messages.
